summary: Still the greatest step we can take is simply step away from some ocial media. 90% of all fake news comes from just seven sources. facebook owns many of them. Fake News isn't hacking. It is using facebook (and Twitter) the way it was designed to maximize profits.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Still the greatest step we can take is simply step away from some ocial media. 90% of all fake news comes from just seven sources. facebook owns many of them. Fake News isn't hacking. It is using facebook (and Twitter) the way it was designed to maximize profits.
